Software & Systems
- Mango Mint
- GoHighLevel, Pipedrive, or similar CRM platforms
- EHR/EMR systems
- Calendar and scheduling platforms
- Google Workspace / Microsoft Office

Experience Requirements
- Strong healthcare operations or patient care coordination experience, ideally within a medical or aesthetic practice.
- Excellent verbal and written English communication skills, especially for patient-facing interactions.
- Experience with CRM systems such as GoHighLevel, Pipedrive, or similar platforms.
- Familiarity with EHR systems; Mango Mint experience is preferred but not required. - open to hiring VAs with similar EHR background
- Client will do the training in case
- Strong organizational and administrative skills, with the ability to manage multiple patients, follow-ups, and timelines.
- Proactive and independent, with the ability to take ownership of

without constant supervision.
- Detail-oriented with strong follow-through, particularly when tracking treatment plans and patient touchpoints.
- Comfortable documenting, systematizing, and improving workflows and identifying opportunities for automation.
- Professional, empathetic, and personable when communicating with patients.
- Ambitious and growth-oriented, with a willingness to grow alongside the business.
- Comfortable providing ideas, recommendations, and insights based on previous experience.
- Adaptable and willing to learn, including new systems, workflows, and clinical concepts.
- Someone who can become a true business partner rather than simply a task executor.
- Someone who wants to be engaged in the clinic a go getter and a true partner.

Deal Breakers
- Poor or unclear English communication skills, especially for patient-facing conversations.
- Lack of professionalism, empathy, or confidence when communicating with patients.
- Someone who requires constant supervision or step-by-step direction and does not take initiative.
- Poor organization or follow-through, particularly with patient leads, treatment plans, and scheduled follow-ups.
- Not comfortable learning or working with EHR and CRM systems.
- Unable to manage multiple patient workflows, deadlines, and touchpoints simultaneously.
- Resistant to feedback, process changes, or learning new clinical concepts.
- A strictly task-oriented mindset without the willingness to contribute ideas, improve processes, or grow into a business-partner role.
- Any concerns regarding reliability, confidentiality, or HIPAA compliance, given the handling of sensitive patient information.

Basic Requirements
- Must speak and write English clearly and professionally.
- Must have relevant work experience.
- Must be able to provide an NBI Clearance and/or Local Police Clearance before onboarding (mandatory).
- Must be available to attend video meetings with camera on when required.

Technical Requirements
- Computer: Reliable laptop or desktop computer.
- Internet: Stable high-speed internet connection (minimum 25 Mbps).
- Audio: Noise-canceling headset.
- Video: Working webcam for virtual meetings.
- Workspace: Quiet and professional work environment.
- Dedicated HR & Contractor Support Team: Access to world-class support for questions, guidance, contract matters, and client communication.
- Premium VPN Access (Optional): A secure VPN license can be provided upon request to enhance privacy and security for client-related tasks.
- HIPAA & Cybersecurity Training + Certification (Provided): Access to our internal HIPAA compliance training, cybersecurity modules, and certification to help you confidently handle PHI for U.S. healthcare clients.
- Top 1% VA Performance Training: Access to our proprietary training on communication, client management, productivity systems, and best practices to help you become a top-performing VA and increase long-term client retention.
- Client-Approved U.S. Holidays: Contractors may take U.S. holidays off according to the client's needs and schedule.
- Client-Approved Paid or Unpaid Time Off: Time off may be granted by your client. Paid time off is optional and only if offered by the client.
- Access to Tools & Resources: Templates, workflow guides, productivity tools, and client-specific SOP support to help you perform at your best.
- Optional Performance-Based Incentives: Some clients may offer bonuses, incentives, or increased hours based on your performance.

These are optional resources and client-approved allowances available to you as an independent contractor. Any resources, training, or allowances listed are optional contractor perks and not employee benefits.
